propositions: Five tests with assertions that cannot fail carry docstrings promising contracts they never check, masking test gaps and defeating coverage reports
test_the_pat_never_appears_in_the_repr_of_the_transport constructs a transport that never receives a PAT and asserts its absence from a default repr, making the test tautological
test_the_structural_guard_fires_on_a_synthetic_unpaginated_caller re-implements the pagination predicate inline instead of calling the shared helper, so it cannot detect regressions in that helper
_search_issues_calls_taking_the_default() hardcodes its input source and takes no parameters, blocking the teeth test from feeding it a synthetic unpaginated source
validate_assignee_exists return value contract is unasserted; the test only checks hasattr, duplicating an existing parametrized presence test
rate-limit retry sweep asserts total <= 1 (satisfied by 0) instead of total == 1, allowing members that fail pre-flight to pass without exercising the 429 branch
